input.command: cd /repo 2>/dev/null || pwd; ls -la; cat README.md 2>/dev/null | head -100
ls data/; wc -l data/*.txt 2>/dev/null; cat example.sh | head -40; cat tdlm_config.py
until docker images | grep -q "python.*2.7"; do sleep 5; done; echo done; docker images | grep python
cd "$(pwd)" && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/repo:ro -w /repo python:2.7 bash -c "pip install --trusted-host pypi.org --trusted-host files.pythonhosted.org tensorflow==0.12.1 gensim 2>&1 | tail -30"

mkdir -p /tmp/tdlm_out
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/repo:ro -v /tmp/tdlm_out:/tmp/tdlm_out -w /tmp/work python:2.7 bash -c "
pip install --quiet --trusted-host pypi.org --trusted-host files.pythonhosted.org tensorflow==0.12.1 gensim 2>&1 | tail -3
mkdir -p /tmp/work && cp -r /repo/* /tmp/work/ && cd /tmp/work
sed -i \"s#output_dir=\\\"output\\\"#output_dir=\\\"/tmp/tdlm_out\\\"#\" tdlm_config.py
python tdlm_train.py 2>&1 | tail -60
"

agent_parsed_json.verdict_reason: Code and environment (Python 2.7 + TF 0.12.1 + gensim) work correctly end-to-end (train/test/topic-generation all succeed on toy data), but the paper's actual benchmark datasets (APNEWS, IMDB, BNC) are unavailable — the official IBM Box download link referenced in the README returns 404 — so the reported perplexity/coherence numbers in the paper cannot be reproduced, only the toy example.
